svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Segoe UI Web, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Option B: licensed data with Azure pricing rules
svg.desc: Hybrid option: a licensed data provider delivers matched competitor prices, a small Azure solution applies HoppNShop margin, shipping, and rounding rules, and a review app pushes approved prices back to Shopify.
svg.metadata: version=1.0; updated=2026-11-05; generator=build_diagram.py; icons=Azure Architecture Icons V25 and Microsoft Entra icons (Oct 2023). Shopify and the data provider are third-party systems and use neutral glyphs.

text.tspan: Option B: licensed data with Azure pricing rules
Hybrid: buy matched competitor data, own the pricing rules and approval workflow

svg.text: Shopify store -> price sync: the Shopify Admin API exports SKUs, prices, and unit costs
Licensed data provider -> price sync: the provider delivers matched competitor prices on a schedule
Price sync -> pricing rules: accepted matches are joined to costs, shipping charges, and margin floors
Pricing rules -> review app: recommendations and price-gap status are saved for review
Review app -> pricing team: analysts approve or reject prices with the evidence in view
Pricing team -> Shopify store: approved prices are pushed through the Shopify Admin API
